restaurantName: Mad Hatter's Afternoon Tea at Sanderson London
bio: Experience the magic of Alice In Wonderland, with the famous Mad Hatter's Afternoon Tea at Sanderson London. Indulge in whimsical sweets and savouries inspired by the characters from the beloved story.  The new menu will inspire you to make the best decisions...Are you courageous enough to take on the Red Knight Army Soul pastry? Playful enough to enjoy the Tweedle Brothers sandwich? Curious enough to try the Alice Psychedelic Mushroom?  Choose from a range of bespoke tea flavours, including The Mad Hatter – green tea infused with passion fruit, guava & mango, Cheshire Cat – marmalade orange oolong tea infused with chocolate & orange, plus a few more exciting flavours.  Blending exquisite views over the green and spacious courtyard garden, with its own visionary design, The Restaurant at Sanderson is the perfect setting to tumble down the rabbit hole. Please note Courtyard seating is subject to availability.  Nestled in the heart of Fitzrovia, Sanderson London is London’s original lifestyle hotel, only minutes from the vibrant Carnaby Street, historical British landmarks, exciting activities, and the main shopping district in Oxford Circus.  Please note that Sanderson London require a card authentication in order to secure your booking. A member of their team will contact you when they receive your enquiry to arrange this.
